Engine notes: 40:21 قبيحة is likely the engine for bish3a (her chat bish3a, she says he never forgets it) - not filed; 03:31/03:36 أملكت likely 3emlat(ha); 07:10 بوع = bu2a3 (بقعة, dropped ق - S4, not filed); 15:04 بتي = بطيء (S4); 49:59 his 'كان يزعل' after her بيزهأ is likely يزهق misheard; 52:17 'نفس الـ issue' likely نفس الإشي. Rule-quiz answers (16:09 أغلب takes no ال, 28:15, 33:44 ال...) treated as questions about the rule, not slips. Self-fixes skipped: 14:09 لا->ما, 14:19 جديد->جديدة, 17:43 فكر->بفكر, 22:30 محلي->في محلي, 35:14 بدلي->بدلة, 39:17 kundaret->kundara, 53:21 إجازة->اجتماع. 56:32 ruhna vs rawwa7na: she offered both, not a slip.

He said خريف (autumn) for خروف (lamb); she echoed خريف and asked what it means, he switched to خروف; her chat la7met 5aroof.

rows.amal_said: واحدة. Because it's ساعة. ... الساعة واحدة or just واحدة.
rows.why: Telling the time he said masculine واحد; she said واحدة 'because it's ساعة' - clock time takes the feminine number.
He said عنده (it has) stains; she recast 'on it' / عليه بقع and typed 3alaih bu2a3 - wrong preposition for 'on it'.
rows.english: And it has stains on it.

rows.why: He said he forgot the word for beets; she supplied بنجر - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: wait for you would be ستنت لك، ستنيت لك،
rows.why: He put 'you' on la- (ستنيت لك); she said استنيتك and 'No L' - the object rides on the verb.

rows.medi_said: حكيت لي ني؟ ... حكيت، حكيت لي لي؟
rows.why: He tacked -ni onto حكيت لي; she said 'No. Try again' then حكيت لي - with la- 'me' is -li, not -ni.

rows.amal_said: هلأ قصدك إنه أغلب ما بتحتاج ال أو الكلمة اللي بعدها.
rows.why: He negated a verb with مش; she restated it as ما بتحتاج and he then said ما بتحتاج at 17:51.

rows.medi_said: Because it's mostly like أغلب men most-- no? Uh, أغلب...
rows.amal_said: لا، it's not the first time we discussed this. We never say أغلب من.
rows.why: He built 'most of' as أغلب من; she said 'We never say أغلب من' - أغلب takes the noun directly like idafa.

rows.medi_said: so ٱغْلَب most people because it's not ٱلنَّاسُ, so it'd be ٱغْلَب النَّاسِ.
rows.amal_said: أغلب after it there's ال. Why did you take it out?
rows.why: Her 'Why did you take it out?' and his 'because ناس is not definitive' show he said أغلب ناس without el- (engine wrote النَّاسِ); after أغلب the noun takes el-.

rows.medi_said: How do you say my clothes? Is it أَوَا...
rows.why: He asked how to say 'my clothes'; she supplied أواعيي - a didn't-know.

rows.amal_said: نفس never takes ال before it. Al-always after it.
rows.why: He put el- on نفس after the noun; she named the rule: نفس never takes ال, the ال goes on the noun after it.

rows.amal_said: صح. ... نفس never takes ال before it always after and it's before the noun.
rows.why: He said أشخاص النفس; she restated the rule (no ال on نفس, it goes before the noun) and he fixed to نفس الأشخاص.

rows.amal_said: Why ال آخر؟ ... آخر الأسبوع صح، بس مش ال آخر الأسبوع. أغلب آخر الأسبوع.
rows.why: In a three-noun chain he put el- on آخر; she said not ال آخر - only the last noun takes el-.

rows.medi_said: أغلب أسبوع الأخر. That sounds so awkward.
rows.why: He flipped the chain to أسبوع الأخر; she recast أغلب آخر الأسبوع and he repeated it.
He used MSA شاطئ; her sheet has 'beach | Sha66 | شط' and her chat typed el-shatt; she let it pass (only said 'The beach').

rows.why: Her 'شو الأول؟ What's feminine of أول؟' shows he said masculine الأول with feminine بدلة (engine wrote الأولى); he then said أولى.
He used أكثر (most/more) for 'best'; she prompted 'Best ... Better' and he said أحسن.

rows.why: For 'the best one' he said إشي (thing); she prompted 'One. What does one mean?' and he said أحسن واحدة.

For 'the beginning of my day' he said أول اليوم; she prompted the possessive and he said أول يومي.

For 'my whole day' he said كل اليوم; she prompted 'My whole day' and he said كل يومي.

rows.why: He used العربية (Arabic / the Arab f.) for 'Arabs'; she gave العرب or العربيين.

rows.chat: taani ijtimaa3 kaan nafs awal waa7ad
rows.why: In the past he dropped كان; she prompted 'Was...' and he said 'Oh، كان'.
rows.english: The second meeting was the same ...

rows.medi_said: نفس أول، ... yeah، just نفس أول. ... Yeah، just أول، right?
rows.amal_said: No، آآ go on. أول شو؟ ... What's one? What's one?
rows.chat: taani ijtimaa3 kaan nafs awal waa7ad
rows.why: He stopped at نفس أول for 'the same as the first one'; she prompted 'أول شو؟ What's one?' and he added واحد.
rows.english: the same as the first one
rows.proposed_rule: 'The first one / the best one' needs واحد/واحدة after the ordinal or superlative: nafs awal waa7ad, a7san wa7de.

rows.chat: ba3ed ma shufna enno tani mat3am kaan nafs el-ishi, rawwa7na
rows.why: He used the I-form shufit for 'we saw'; she prompted 'we saw' and he said shufna.

rows.medi_said: Ba'id ma shufna. After we saw...
rows.amal_said: That. You didn't-- You did-- You need a that here.

rows.why: He went straight from shufna to the clause; she said 'You need a that here' and he said enno.
rows.proposed_rule: After a seeing/knowing/saying verb, a following clause needs enno (that): ba3ed ma shufna enno tani mat3am kaan nafs el-ishi.

rows.chat: ba3ed ma shufna enno tani mat3am kaan nafs el-ishi, rawwa7na
